162	
163	\(a\) *Payment Default.* Failure by the Borrower to pay when due any principal of the Second Lien Term Loan (a \"**Payment Default**\").
164	
165	\(b\) *Interest/Fee Payment Default.* Failure by the Borrower to pay any interest on the Second Lien Term Loan or any fee or other amount payable hereunder or under any other Loan Document within five (5) Business Days after the date when due.
166	
167	\(c\) *Representation and Warranty Default.* Any representation or warranty made or deemed made by any Loan Party in this Agreement or in any other Loan Document, or in any certificate, document, or financial statement delivered in connection herewith or therewith, shall prove to have been incorrect in any material respect when made or deemed made.
168	
169	\(d\) *Covenant Default.* Failure by any Loan Party to perform or observe any covenant or agreement contained in this Agreement or any other Loan Document (other than those described in clauses (a) and (b) above), and such failure shall continue unremedied for a period of thirty (30) days after the earlier of (i) written notice thereof from the Administrative Agent to the Borrower and (ii) the date on which a Responsible Officer of the Borrower has actual knowledge of such failure.
170	
171	\(e\) *Cross-Default.* The occurrence of an event of default under any agreement or instrument evidencing or governing Indebtedness of the Borrower or any Subsidiary in an aggregate principal amount exceeding \$15,000,000 (other than Indebtedness under this Agreement), or any such Indebtedness shall be declared to be due and payable or required to be prepaid (other than by a regularly scheduled required prepayment) prior to its stated maturity.
172	
173	\(f\) *Bankruptcy.* The commencement of an involuntary or voluntary case or proceeding under any Debtor Relief Law by or against the Borrower, Holdings, or any Material Subsidiary (a \"**Bankruptcy Event of Default**\"), including the filing of a petition in bankruptcy, the appointment of a receiver, trustee, or custodian, or the making of an assignment for the benefit of creditors; *provided* that, with respect to any involuntary case or proceeding, such case or proceeding shall not have been dismissed within sixty (60) days of the commencement thereof.
174	
175	\(g\) *Judgment Default.* One or more final, non-appealable judgments, orders, or decrees for the payment of money in an aggregate amount exceeding \$15,000,000 (to the extent not covered by insurance as to which the insurer has acknowledged coverage) shall be rendered against the Borrower, any Guarantor, or any combination thereof and shall remain undischarged for a period of sixty (60) consecutive days during which execution shall not be effectively stayed.
176	
177	\(h\) *ERISA.* The occurrence of one or more ERISA Events that, individually or in the aggregate, could reasonably be expected to result in liability of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries in an aggregate amount exceeding \$10,000,000.
178	
179	\(i\) *Invalidity of Loan Documents.* Any material provision of any Loan Document shall at any time for any reason cease to be valid and binding on any Loan Party, or any Lien purported to be created by any Second Lien Collateral Document shall cease to be a valid and perfected Lien on the Collateral (with the priority required hereby or by the applicable Second Lien Collateral Document), except to the extent permitted by the Intercreditor Agreement.
180	
181	\(j\) *Change of Control.* The occurrence of a Change of Control.
182	
183	**[Section 8.02 --- Remedies]{.underline}**
184	
185	\(a\) Upon the occurrence and during the continuance of any Event of Default, the Administrative Agent may, and at the request of the Required Lenders shall, by notice to the Borrower, (i) declare all outstanding Second Lien Obligations to be immediately due and payable, without presentment, demand, protest, or other notice of any kind, all of which are hereby expressly waived by each Loan Party, (ii) require the Borrower to cash collateralize any outstanding obligations, and (iii) exercise any and all rights and remedies available to the Second Lien Secured Parties under the Loan Documents, at law, or in equity.
186	
187	\(b\) Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this Section 8.02, the exercise of any remedies with respect to the Collateral (including the commencement of any foreclosure action, the exercise of any right of sale, or any other action to enforce any Lien on the Collateral) shall be subject to the terms and conditions of the Intercreditor Agreement, including any applicable standstill period set forth therein.
188	
189	\(c\) In the event of any Bankruptcy Event of Default described in Section 8.01(f), all outstanding Second Lien Obligations shall automatically become immediately due and payable without any declaration or other act on the part of the Administrative Agent or any Lender.

193	**[Section 9.18 --- Intercreditor Matters]{.underline}**

195	\(a\) *Acknowledgement and Consent.* Each Second Lien Lender, by its acceptance of the benefits of this Agreement, (i) acknowledges that it has received a copy of the Intercreditor Agreement, (ii) consents to the subordination of the Liens securing the Second Lien Obligations to the Liens securing the First Lien Obligations on the terms set forth in the Intercreditor Agreement, and (iii) agrees to be bound by the terms thereof.
196	
197	\(b\) *DIP Financing.* Each Second Lien Lender agrees that, in any Insolvency Proceeding, it will not object to, and hereby consents to, any debtor-in-possession financing provided to the Borrower or any Guarantor that is secured by Liens on the Collateral with priority equal to or senior to the Liens securing the First Lien Obligations, provided that the aggregate principal amount of such debtor-in-possession financing does not exceed the sum of (i) the aggregate principal amount outstanding under the First Lien Credit Agreement at the time of the filing of such Insolvency Proceeding, plus (ii) \$30,000,000.
198	
199	\(c\) *Adequate Protection.* In any Insolvency Proceeding, each Second Lien Lender agrees that (i) it will not seek or accept adequate protection in the form of Liens on the Collateral that are senior to or pari passu with the Liens securing the First Lien Obligations (or any debtor-in-possession financing that refinances or replaces such obligations), and (ii) it will accept adequate protection solely in the form of (A) replacement Liens on the Collateral, which Liens shall be subordinated to (1) the Liens securing the First Lien Obligations, (2) any Liens securing debtor-in-possession financing consented to under clause (b) above, and (3) any Liens securing adequate protection provided to the First Lien Secured Parties, and (B) superpriority administrative expense claims junior to all superpriority claims of the First Lien Secured Parties.
200	
201	\(d\) *Asset Sales and Insurance/Condemnation.* Each Second Lien Lender agrees that all proceeds of Collateral received in connection with any sale, transfer, or other disposition of Collateral (including any sale under Section 363 of the Bankruptcy Code) or any insurance or condemnation proceeds with respect to Collateral shall be applied first to the payment in full of the First Lien Obligations before any application to the Second Lien Obligations. No Second Lien Lender shall object to any sale of Collateral consented to by the Required First Lien Lenders (as defined in the First Lien Credit Agreement).
202	
203	\(e\) *Plan Voting.* In any Insolvency Proceeding, each Second Lien Lender agrees that it shall not vote in favor of any plan of reorganization (and shall not otherwise support any such plan) that is not accepted by the class of First Lien Lenders, unless the First Lien Obligations are to be paid in full in cash on the effective date of such plan. No Second Lien Lender shall propose or support any plan of reorganization that is inconsistent with the priorities and other terms set forth in the Intercreditor Agreement. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the Second Lien Lenders shall retain all rights to vote on any plan of reorganization to the extent such rights cannot be waived under applicable law.
204	
205	\(f\) *Standstill.* Each Second Lien Lender acknowledges that the Intercreditor Agreement may contain standstill provisions restricting the exercise of remedies by the Second Lien Secured Parties with respect to the Collateral, and each Second Lien Lender agrees to be bound by such standstill provisions.
206	
207	\(g\) *Purchase Option.* The Second Lien Secured Parties shall have the right (but not the obligation) to purchase all (but not less than all) of the First Lien Obligations from the First Lien Secured Parties at a purchase price equal to the full amount of the First Lien Obligations, including the aggregate outstanding principal amount thereof, all accrued and unpaid interest thereon, all fees (including any applicable premiums), and all other amounts owing in respect thereof, exercisable upon the terms and conditions set forth in the Intercreditor Agreement.
208

210	
211	\(i\) *Refinancing.* Each Second Lien Lender acknowledges and agrees that the First Lien Obligations may be refinanced from time to time, and any Permitted First Lien Refinancing Indebtedness shall be entitled to the benefits of the Intercreditor Agreement on substantially the same terms.
212	
213	\(j\) *Amendment Restrictions.* Without the consent of the Required Lenders, no amendment, modification, or waiver of the Second Lien Credit Agreement or any other Second Lien Loan Document shall (i) shorten the Maturity Date to a date earlier than the date that is ninety-one (91) days after the maturity date under the First Lien Credit Agreement (currently July 16, 2031, based on a First Lien maturity of October 15, 2031), (ii) increase the aggregate principal amount of the Second Lien Term Loan Commitments to an amount in excess of \$115,000,000, (iii) add any financial maintenance covenants that are more restrictive than the financial maintenance covenants set forth in the First Lien Credit Agreement, or (iv) add any mandatory prepayment provisions.

B: Diligent-pursuit bar and Insolvency-Proceeding bar on post-standstill SL enforcement (§3.1(b)) and the SL Enforcement Notice requirement.
B: Unsecured-creditor rights reserved to the SL but subject to the ICA, with any judgment lien subordinated (§3.3).
B: Separate-class provision, post-petition interest, reinstatement, relief-from-stay waiver, §363 sale/credit-bid, §1111(b) waiver and no-challenge provisions (Article VI).
B: “Excess First Lien Obligations” treatment — amounts in excess of the hedging/cash management or principal caps remain senior to the SL after the capped amounts (bracketed alternative).
B: Default interest excluded from permitted SL payments; mandatory prepayment and scheduled amortization both blocked in SL amendments (§5.4(a)(iv)).
B: SL refinancing debt must not mature earlier, amortize, or exceed $115 million plus premiums/fees (§5.6(c)).
MH: VI. Closing Checklist Items for the ICA (Target: Execution at Closing, October 15, 2024)
B: Final execution versions of both credit agreements, with conforming changes: SL CA §§1.01 (First Lien Obligations; Consolidated First Lien Net Debt; Unrestricted Cash), 2.06(a), 8.02(a), 9.18(b), 9.18(j); FL CA §§2.18 (hedging cap wording), 12.15(a), 13.02 (AKM notice details).
B: Authority: SL CA §11.02 authorization for the Second Lien Administrative Agent (not just the Collateral Agent); FL CA §12.14 authorization (covers both Pinnacle capacities).
B: Officer’s certificate / agent confirmation of final First Lien Applicable Margin and OID after any Market Flex exercise (baseline for §5.3(a)(iii)).
B: Mortgages for Dayton, OH; Tulsa, OK; Baton Rouge, LA (appraised $87.5 million total): SL mortgages to reference the ICA and be recorded after the FL mortgages; local counsel confirmation of priority recording order.
B: UCC-1s against Borrower, Holdings and the four Domestic Subsidiaries (Delaware, Oklahoma, Louisiana); stock certificates and stock powers (including 65% of CTS Thermal Systems Canada, Ltd. and CTS Europe GmbH) delivered only to FL Collateral Agent as bailee; foreign-law pledge requirements (Ontario; Germany — notarial pledge for GmbH shares) to be confirmed with local counsel for both liens.
B: Deposit account control agreements — FL Collateral Agent control (needed for Unrestricted Cash netting under the FL CA); SL control through bailee provision only.
B: Insurance endorsements naming both agents as lender loss payee/additional insured, with payment to FL Collateral Agent until Discharge.
B: Signature pages from Pinnacle (both capacities), Trident (both capacities), Borrower, Holdings and [subsidiary Guarantors].
B: Strip all AKM Notes and this memorandum before external circulation.
MH: VII. Anticipated Caldwell Reed Pushback (Internal — Fallbacks Only If You Approve)
B: Standstill: 90 days requested; possible fallback 150 days and one restart per 360 days. Hold 180 in first turn.
B: DIP: principal-only cap per SL CA §9.18(b); fallback is to keep obligations-based cap but limit roll-up to prepetition FL Obligations.
B: Adequate protection: will ask for current payment of SL professional fees and pari replacement liens; hold.
B: Voting: will cite SL CA §9.18(e) savings clause; hold, relying on §6.7 backstop.
B: Releases on enforcement, unlimited standstill restart, diligent-pursuit bar, identical-collateral trust and purchase price “full amount” are the next most likely targets.

C: AKM Draft 10/12/2024 — Privileged & Confidential — Subject to FRE 408 and Equivalent State Rules
T: FIRST LIEN/SECOND LIEN INTERCREDITOR AGREEMENT
C: dated as of October 15, 2024
C: among
C: **PINNACLE CREDIT ADVISORS LLC,**
C: as First Lien Administrative Agent and First Lien Collateral Agent,
C: **TRIDENT CAPITAL MARKETS LLC,**
C: as Second Lien Administrative Agent and Second Lien Collateral Agent,

P: This **FIRST LIEN/SECOND LIEN INTERCREDITOR AGREEMENT** (this “**Agreement**”), dated as of October 15, 2024, is entered into by and among **PINNACLE CREDIT ADVISORS LLC**, in its capacities as administrative agent (in such capacity, together with its successors and assigns in such capacity, the “**First Lien Administrative Agent**”) and collateral agent (in such capacity, together with its successors and assigns in such capacity, the “**First Lien Collateral Agent**” and, together with the First Lien Administrative Agent, the “**First Lien Agent**”) for the First Lien Secured Parties, and **TRIDENT CAPITAL MARKETS LLC**, in its capacities as administrative agent (in such capacity, together with its successors and assigns in such capacity, the “**Second Lien Administrative Agent**”) and collateral agent (in such capacity, together with its successors and assigns in such capacity, the “**Second Lien Collateral Agent**” and, together with the Second Lien Administrative Agent, the “**Second Lien Agent**”) for the Second Lien Secured Parties, and is acknowledged and agreed to by **CONSOLIDATED THERMAL SYSTEMS, INC.**, a Delaware corporation (the “**Borrower**”), **CTS ACQUISITION HOLDINGS, LLC**, a Delaware limited liability company (“**Holdings**”), [and the other Grantors party hereto].
N: The instructions list Pinnacle only as First Lien Collateral Agent and Trident only as Second Lien Collateral Agent. The First Lien Credit Agreement defines the “Intercreditor Agreement” as among the “First Lien Agent” (defined in §1.01 and §12.14(b) as the Administrative Agent and the Collateral Agent collectively), the Second Lien Agent, the Borrower and Holdings. Because the payment blockage, acceleration and turnover covenants must bind the Second Lien Administrative Agent (which controls acceleration under Second Lien Credit Agreement §8.02(a)), we have each agent sign in both capacities. Second Lien Credit Agreement §11.02 authorizes only the Second Lien Collateral Agent; Caldwell Reed should confirm the Administrative Agent’s authority. The subsidiary Guarantors (CTS Engineering Solutions, Inc., CTS Fabrication Services, LLC, CTS Assembly & Testing, LLC and CTS IP Holdings, Inc.) grant Liens under both facilities and are bracketed as acknowledging Grantors; confirm with Thornburg.
H1: RECITALS
P: WHEREAS, the Borrower, Holdings, the lenders from time to time party thereto and Pinnacle Credit Advisors LLC, as administrative agent and collateral agent, are parties to the First Lien Credit Agreement, pursuant to which such lenders have made or agreed to make a term loan facility in an aggregate principal amount of $310,000,000 and a revolving credit facility in an aggregate principal amount of $55,000,000;
P: WHEREAS, the Borrower, Holdings, the lenders from time to time party thereto and Trident Capital Markets LLC, as administrative agent and collateral agent, are parties to the Second Lien Credit Agreement, pursuant to which such lenders have made a term loan in an aggregate principal amount of $115,000,000;
P: WHEREAS, the obligations of the Borrower under each of the First Lien Credit Agreement and the Second Lien Credit Agreement are guaranteed by Holdings and the other Guarantors and are secured by Liens on substantially all of the assets of the Borrower and the Guarantors; and
P: WHEREAS, Section 12.14 of the First Lien Credit Agreement authorizes and directs the First Lien Agent, and Section 11.02 of the Second Lien Credit Agreement authorizes and directs the Second Lien Collateral Agent, to enter into this Agreement on behalf of the applicable Secured Parties and to bind such Secured Parties to its terms, and the parties desire to set forth their agreement as to the relative priority of their respective Liens on the Collateral and certain other rights, priorities and interests;
P: NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the foregoing and the mutual covenants herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the parties agree as follows:
H1: ARTICLE I — DEFINITIONS
S: 1.1|Defined Terms|As used in this Agreement, the following terms have the meanings specified below:
D: Bankruptcy Code|means Title 11 of the United States Code, as amended.
D: Bankruptcy Law|means the Bankruptcy Code and any other federal, state or foreign bankruptcy, insolvency, receivership, reorganization, liquidation, moratorium, arrangement, winding-up or similar debtor relief law, including any “Debtor Relief Law” as defined in either Credit Agreement.
D: Business Day|has the meaning assigned to such term in the First Lien Credit Agreement.
D: Collateral|means all assets and properties of any kind, whether real, personal or mixed, tangible or intangible, now owned or hereafter acquired, of any Grantor upon which a Lien is granted or purported to be granted, or is required to be granted, to secure any First Lien Obligations or any Second Lien Obligations, including all “Collateral” as defined in the First Lien Credit Agreement and in the Second Lien Credit Agreement, and including all Proceeds thereof, and including any such assets and properties subject to a Lien securing any DIP Financing or any adequate protection or replacement Lien.
D: Credit Agreements|means the First Lien Credit Agreement and the Second Lien Credit Agreement.
D: DIP Financing|has the meaning assigned to such term in Section 6.1(a).
D: DIP Financing Liens|means any Liens securing any DIP Financing.
D: Discharge of First Lien Obligations|means, except to the extent otherwise provided in Section 6.4, (a) the payment in full in cash of the principal of and interest (including interest accruing on or after the commencement of any Insolvency Proceeding, whether or not such interest would be allowed in such Insolvency Proceeding) and premium (including the Prepayment Premium), if any, on all Indebtedness outstanding under the First Lien Documents, (b) the payment in full in cash of all other First Lien Obligations that are due and payable or otherwise accrued and owing at or prior to the time such principal and interest are paid (other than contingent indemnification obligations for which no claim or demand has been asserted), (c) the termination or expiration of all commitments to extend credit under the First Lien Documents, (d) the termination of, or cash collateralization (in an amount and manner reasonably satisfactory to the First Lien Agent, but in no event less than 105% of the aggregate undrawn face amount) of, all letters of credit issued under the First Lien Documents, (e) the termination of all Swap Contracts giving rise to Hedging Obligations and the payment in full in cash of all amounts owing thereunder (or other arrangements satisfactory to the applicable Hedge Counterparty) and (f) the payment in full in cash of, or other arrangements satisfactory to the applicable Cash Management Bank with respect to, all Cash Management Obligations. If, after a Discharge of First Lien Obligations has occurred, the Borrower thereafter incurs Refinancing First Lien Obligations in accordance with Section 5.6, then the Discharge of First Lien Obligations shall be deemed not to have occurred for all purposes of this Agreement (other than with respect to any actions taken prior to the date of such incurrence).
D: Discharge of Second Lien Obligations|means the payment in full in cash of all Second Lien Obligations (other than contingent indemnification obligations for which no claim or demand has been asserted) and the termination of all commitments under the Second Lien Documents.
D: Enforcement Action|means any action to (a) foreclose, execute, levy or collect on, take possession or control of, sell or otherwise realize upon (judicially or non-judicially), or lease, license or otherwise dispose of (whether publicly or privately), Collateral, or otherwise exercise or enforce remedial rights with respect to Collateral (including by credit bid, deed in lieu, set-off, notification of account debtors, exercise of rights under control agreements or landlord waivers, or exercise of any voting rights or rights to receive distributions in respect of Equity Interests), (b) solicit bids from third parties or engage a broker or investment banker for the foregoing, (c) receive a transfer of Collateral in satisfaction of Indebtedness, (d) otherwise enforce a Lien or a security interest or exercise any right or remedy as a secured creditor under any Credit Document or applicable law (including the Uniform Commercial Code), (e) demand, sue for, take or receive payment of any Second Lien Obligations (other than Permitted Second Lien Payments) or (f) commence, or join with any Person (other than the First Lien Agent) in commencing, any Insolvency Proceeding against any Grantor.
D: Enforcement Notice|means a written notice delivered by the First Lien Agent to the Second Lien Agent stating that an Event of Default under (and as defined in) the First Lien Credit Agreement has occurred and is continuing and that such notice is an “Enforcement Notice” for purposes of this Agreement.
N: “Enforcement Notice” is used but not defined in the First Lien Credit Agreement excerpts (it appears in the “Standstill Period” definition and §12.15(b)). The full agreement should be checked so that our definition is consistent; if the full agreement does not define it, the First Lien Credit Agreement should cross-refer to this Agreement.
D: Excess First Lien Obligations|means (a) Hedging Obligations and Cash Management Obligations, to the extent in excess of the respective caps set forth in the definitions thereof in the First Lien Credit Agreement, and (b) First Lien Obligations not permitted to be incurred under Section 5.3(a)(ii) solely by reason of exceeding the limitation set forth therein.
N: [Bracketed alternative for partner decision.] The First Lien Credit Agreement caps Hedging Obligations at $25,000,000 __notional__ and Cash Management Obligations at $10,000,000, and §2.18 (Third) expresses the hedging cap as an amount “not to exceed the Hedging Obligations cap of $25,000,000 notional,” mixing a notional cap with an exposure amount. Amounts above the caps would fall outside “First Lien Obligations.” Our draft preserves first-priority status for such excess amounts, but behind the Second Lien Obligations is the market fallback; as drafted here, Excess First Lien Obligations rank __after__ capped First Lien Obligations but __ahead of__ the Second Lien Obligations (Section 4.1). Caldwell Reed will likely insist that Excess First Lien Obligations rank behind the Second Lien. Recommend we also correct the §2.18 language in the First Lien Credit Agreement.
D: First Lien Bankruptcy Default|means (a) an Event of Default under Section 8.01(e) of the First Lien Credit Agreement or (b) whether or not such an Event of Default has then occurred (including prior to the expiration of any 60-day period referred to in such Section), the commencement of any Insolvency Proceeding by or against the Borrower, Holdings or any other Grantor.
D: First Lien Credit Agreement|means that certain First Lien Credit Agreement, dated as of October 15, 2024, among the Borrower, Holdings, the lenders from time to time party thereto, and Pinnacle Credit Advisors LLC, as Administrative Agent and Collateral Agent, as amended, restated, amended and restated, supplemented, extended, replaced, refinanced or otherwise modified from time to time to the extent not prohibited by this Agreement, and any agreement governing Refinancing First Lien Obligations.
D: First Lien Documents|means the First Lien Credit Agreement, the “Loan Documents” (as defined in the First Lien Credit Agreement), the First Lien Security Documents, each Swap Contract giving rise to Hedging Obligations, each agreement giving rise to Cash Management Obligations, and each other agreement, instrument or document evidencing, securing or governing any First Lien Obligations.
D: First Lien Lenders|means the “Lenders” under and as defined in the First Lien Credit Agreement.
D: First Lien Liens|means all Liens on the Collateral securing the First Lien Obligations, whether created under the First Lien Security Documents or acquired by possession, statute, operation of law, subrogation or otherwise.
D: First Lien Net Leverage Ratio|has the meaning assigned to such term in the First Lien Credit Agreement (including the definitions of “Consolidated First Lien Net Debt,” “Unrestricted Cash,” “Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA” and “Test Period” used therein), as in effect from time to time.
N: Conflict. The Second Lien Credit Agreement has its own definitions of “First Lien Net Leverage Ratio” and “Consolidated First Lien Net Debt” that (i) do not cap cash netting at $25,000,000, (ii) use a different “Unrestricted Cash” definition (cash not subject to Liens other than the agents’, versus cash in accounts subject to control agreements in favor of the First Lien Collateral Agent) and (iii) use Adjusted EBITDA as defined in the First Lien Credit Agreement “as in effect on the Closing Date.” The Second Lien definitions are looser and would make the Second Lien prepayment test easier to satisfy. Per instructions, the ICA uses the First Lien Credit Agreement definitions; Second Lien Credit Agreement §2.06(a) should be conformed.
D: First Lien Obligations|means all “First Lien Obligations” as defined in the First Lien Credit Agreement, including (a) all Loans, Letter of Credit Obligations, fees, interest (including interest at the Default Rate and interest accruing after the commencement of any Insolvency Proceeding, whether or not allowed or allowable as a claim in such Insolvency Proceeding), premiums (including the Prepayment Premium), reimbursement obligations, indemnification obligations, Protective Advances and all other amounts owing to the First Lien Secured Parties under the First Lien Documents, (b) all Hedging Obligations, (c) all Cash Management Obligations, (d) all Excess First Lien Obligations, (e) all DIP Financing provided by, or consented to by, the First Lien Secured Parties, and (f) all Refinancing First Lien Obligations, in each case whether now existing or hereafter arising, and whether or not allowed or allowable in any Insolvency Proceeding. To the extent any payment with respect to the First Lien Obligations is declared to be fraudulent or preferential or is otherwise required to be repaid, then the obligations so repaid shall be deemed to be reinstated and outstanding as First Lien Obligations for all purposes hereof.
N: Per instructions, the definition is tied to the First Lien Credit Agreement definition, which already includes Hedging Obligations (up to $25,000,000 notional) and Cash Management Obligations (up to $10,000,000) and post-petition interest. Note that the Second Lien Credit Agreement defines First Lien Obligations more narrowly (Obligations “under or in connection with the First Lien Credit Agreement and the First Lien Loan Documents”), which may not capture obligations under separate swap and cash management agreements; this Agreement controls (Second Lien Credit Agreement §§6.03, 11.02(c)), but the Second Lien definition should be conformed.
D: First Lien Payment Default|means an Event of Default under Section 8.01(a) of the First Lien Credit Agreement (including, for the avoidance of doubt, any failure to pay principal, interest, fees or other amounts when due after giving effect to any applicable grace period).
N: The Second Lien Credit Agreement (§2.06(a)) refers to a “Payment Default or Bankruptcy Event of Default (each as defined in the First Lien Credit Agreement),” but the First Lien Credit Agreement does not define those terms — it uses them only as captions to §8.01(a) and (e). The Second Lien Credit Agreement separately defines “Payment Default” (principal only) and “Bankruptcy Event of Default” (Material Subsidiary) for its own purposes. The ICA definitions avoid the ambiguity. The First Lien Bankruptcy Default definition is first-lien-favorable in that blockage applies upon commencement of an involuntary case without waiting for the 60-day dismissal period.
D: First Lien Secured Parties|means the First Lien Agent, the First Lien Lenders, each issuing bank, each Hedge Counterparty, each Cash Management Bank and each other “Secured Party” under and as defined in the First Lien Credit Agreement, and their respective successors and assigns.
D: First Lien Security Documents|means the “Security Documents” as defined in the First Lien Credit Agreement and any other agreement, document or instrument pursuant to which a Lien is granted to secure any First Lien Obligations.
D: Grantors|means the Borrower, Holdings, each other Guarantor and each other Person that has granted or purports to grant a Lien on any of its assets to secure any First Lien Obligations or Second Lien Obligations. As of the date hereof, the Grantors other than the Borrower and Holdings are CTS Engineering Solutions, Inc., a Delaware corporation, CTS Fabrication Services, LLC, an Oklahoma limited liability company, CTS Assembly & Testing, LLC, a Louisiana limited liability company, and CTS IP Holdings, Inc., a Delaware corporation.
D: Guarantors|means the “Guarantors” as defined in the First Lien Credit Agreement and the “Guarantors” as defined in the Second Lien Credit Agreement.
N: The Guarantor definitions do not match. Under the First Lien Credit Agreement, a future Domestic Subsidiary becomes a Guarantor only upon joining the Guarantee Agreement under §6.12; under the Second Lien Credit Agreement, “Guarantors” means Holdings and “each existing and future Domestic Restricted Subsidiary” automatically. The instructions refer to “domestic restricted subsidiaries.” Section 2.3 below requires the guarantor groups to be identical and requires any Second Lien-only guarantee or Lien to be held in trust for the First Lien Secured Parties.

D: Payment Blockage Notice|has the meaning assigned to such term in Section 12.15(a) of the First Lien Credit Agreement and shall include any written notice delivered by the First Lien Agent to the Second Lien Agent stating that a First Lien Payment Default or First Lien Bankruptcy Default has occurred and is continuing.

D: Proceeds|means (a) all “proceeds” as defined in Article 9 of the Uniform Commercial Code with respect to any Collateral and (b) whatever is recoverable or recovered when Collateral is sold, exchanged, collected or disposed of, whether voluntarily or involuntarily, including insurance proceeds and condemnation awards and any payment or distribution in any Insolvency Proceeding in respect of Collateral.
D: Recovery|has the meaning assigned to such term in Section 6.4.
D: Refinance|means, in respect of any Indebtedness, to refinance, extend, renew, defease, amend, restate, increase, modify, supplement, restructure, refund, replace or repay, or to issue other Indebtedness in exchange or replacement for such Indebtedness, in whole or in part; and “**Refinanced**” and “**Refinancing**” have correlative meanings.
D: Refinancing First Lien Obligations|means obligations under any Indebtedness that Refinances First Lien Obligations in accordance with Section 5.6.
D: Required First Lien Lenders|means the “Required Lenders” as defined in the First Lien Credit Agreement.
D: Required Second Lien Lenders|means the “Required Lenders” as defined in the Second Lien Credit Agreement.

Confirm the Second Lien “Required Lenders” definition in the full execution version.

D: Second Lien Enforcement Notice|means a written notice delivered by the Second Lien Agent to the First Lien Agent stating that an Event of Default under (and as defined in) the Second Lien Credit Agreement has occurred and is continuing, that the Second Lien Obligations have been accelerated in accordance with the Second Lien Credit Agreement, and that the Second Lien Agent intends to commence Enforcement Actions.
D: Second Lien Lenders|means the “Lenders” under and as defined in the Second Lien Credit Agreement.
D: Second Lien Liens|means all Liens on the Collateral securing the Second Lien Obligations, whether created under the Second Lien Security Documents or acquired by possession, statute (including any judgment lien), operation of law, subrogation or otherwise.
D: Second Lien Obligations|means all “Second Lien Obligations” as defined in the Second Lien Credit Agreement, including all principal, interest (including interest accruing after the commencement of any Insolvency Proceeding, whether or not allowed), fees, premiums, indemnification obligations and other amounts owing under the Second Lien Documents.
D: Second Lien Secured Parties|means the Second Lien Agent, the Second Lien Lenders and each other “Second Lien Secured Party” under and as defined in the Second Lien Credit Agreement, and their respective successors and assigns.
D: Second Lien Security Documents|means the “Second Lien Collateral Documents” as defined in the Second Lien Credit Agreement and any other agreement, document or instrument pursuant to which a Lien is granted to secure any Second Lien Obligations.
D: Secured Parties|means the First Lien Secured Parties and the Second Lien Secured Parties.
D: Standstill Period|means the period commencing on the date of delivery by the First Lien Agent to the Second Lien Agent of an Enforcement Notice or a Payment Blockage Notice and ending on the date that is 180 days thereafter; __provided__ that, if a new Event of Default under the First Lien Credit Agreement that is distinct from the Event of Default giving rise to the then-existing Standstill Period occurs during such Standstill Period and the First Lien Agent delivers a new Enforcement Notice or Payment Blockage Notice with respect thereto, the Standstill Period shall restart on the date of delivery of such new notice and shall end on the date that is 180 days thereafter, and there shall be no limit on the number of such restarts; __provided further__ that the Standstill Period shall be deemed to be continuing at all times during which any Insolvency Proceeding is pending.
N: The 180-day period and the unlimited restart track the First Lien Credit Agreement “Standstill Period” definition and §12.15(b). The unlimited restart was not in the instructions but is in our own credit agreement; omitting it would create an inconsistency Caldwell Reed would exploit in the other direction. Expect this to be one of the most contested points (market: no more than one blockage per 360 days). Do not concede in the first draft. The final proviso (standstill continues during an Insolvency Proceeding) is first-lien-favorable and supported by the bankruptcy provisions in Article VI.
D: Uniform Commercial Code|means the Uniform Commercial Code as in effect from time to time in the State of New York or, where applicable to any Collateral, any other jurisdiction.
S: 1.2|Terms Generally|Capitalized terms used but not defined herein (including “Cash Management Bank,” “Cash Management Obligations,” “Equity Interests,” “Event of Default,” “Hedge Counterparty,” “Hedging Obligations,” “Indebtedness,” “Letter of Credit Obligations,” “Prepayment Premium,” “Protective Advance,” “Revolving Commitment” and “Swap Contract”) have the meanings given in the First Lien Credit Agreement. The definitions of terms herein shall apply equally to the singular and plural forms. The words “include,” “includes” and “including” shall be deemed followed by “without limitation.” References to any agreement mean such agreement as amended, restated, supplemented or otherwise modified from time to time in accordance with this Agreement. References to “payment in full” of First Lien Obligations mean the Discharge of First Lien Obligations. Section and Article headings are for convenience only. Any reference to the “Required First Lien Lenders” or “First Lien Agent” consenting to or directing any action shall mean consent or direction in accordance with the First Lien Credit Agreement.

N: The instructions list Pinnacle only as First Lien Collateral Agent and Trident only as Second Lien Collateral Agent. H1: ARTICLE I — DEFINITIONS
S: 1.1|Defined Terms|As used in this Agreement, the following terms have the meanings specified below:

If, after a Discharge of First Lien Obligations has occurred, the Borrower thereafter incurs Refinancing First Lien Obligations in accordance with Section 5.6, then the Discharge of First Lien Obligations shall be deemed not to have occurred for all purposes of this Agreement (other than with respect to any actions taken prior to the date of such incurrence).

D: Enforcement Notice|means a written notice delivered by the First Lien Agent to the Second Lien Agent stating that an Event of Default under (and as defined in) the First Lien Credit Agreement has occurred and is continuing and that such notice is an “Enforcement Notice” for purposes of this Agreement.

The full agreement should be checked so that our definition is consistent; if the full agreement does not define it, the First Lien Credit Agreement should cross-refer to this Agreement.
D: Excess First Lien Obligations|means (a) Hedging Obligations and Cash Management Obligations, to the extent in excess of the respective caps set forth in the definitions thereof in the First Lien Credit Agreement, and (b) First Lien Obligations not permitted to be incurred under Section 5.3(a)(ii) solely by reason of exceeding the limitation set forth therein.
N: [Bracketed alternative for partner decision.] The First Lien Credit Agreement caps Hedging Obligations at $25,000,000 __notional__ and Cash Management Obligations at $10,000,000, and §2.18 (Third) expresses the hedging cap as an amount “not to exceed the Hedging Obligations cap of $25,000,000 notional,” mixing a notional cap with an exposure amount. D: First Lien Bankruptcy Default|means (a) an Event of Default under Section 8.01(e) of the First Lien Credit Agreement or (b) whether or not such an Event of Default has then occurred (including prior to the expiration of any 60-day period referred to in such Section), the commencement of any Insolvency Proceeding by or against the Borrower, Holdings or any other Grantor.
D: First Lien Credit Agreement|means that certain First Lien Credit Agreement, dated as of October 15, 2024, among the Borrower, Holdings, the lenders from time to time party thereto, and Pinnacle Credit Advisors LLC, as Administrative Agent and Collateral Agent, as amended, restated, amended and restated, supplemented, extended, replaced, refinanced or otherwise modified from time to time to the extent not prohibited by this Agreement, and any agreement governing Refinancing First Lien Obligations.

D: First Lien Net Leverage Ratio|has the meaning assigned to such term in the First Lien Credit Agreement (including the definitions of “Consolidated First Lien Net Debt,” “Unrestricted Cash,” “Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA” and “Test Period” used therein), as in effect from time to time.
N: Conflict. The Second Lien Credit Agreement has its own definitions of “First Lien Net Leverage Ratio” and “Consolidated First Lien Net Debt” that (i) do not cap cash netting at $25,000,000, (ii) use a different “Unrestricted Cash” definition (cash not subject to Liens other than the agents’, versus cash in accounts subject to control agreements in favor of the First Lien Collateral Agent) and (iii) use Adjusted EBITDA as defined in the First Lien Credit Agreement “as in effect on the Closing Date.” The Second Lien definitions are looser and would make the Second Lien prepayment test easier to satisfy. D: First Lien Obligations|means all “First Lien Obligations” as defined in the First Lien Credit Agreement, including (a) all Loans, Letter of Credit Obligations, fees, interest (including interest at the Default Rate and interest accruing after the commencement of any Insolvency Proceeding, whether or not allowed or allowable as a claim in such Insolvency Proceeding), premiums (including the Prepayment Premium), reimbursement obligations, indemnification obligations, Protective Advances and all other amounts owing to the First Lien Secured Parties under the First Lien Documents, (b) all Hedging Obligations, (c) all Cash Management Obligations, (d) all Excess First Lien Obligations, (e) all DIP Financing provided by, or consented to by, the First Lien Secured Parties, and (f) all Refinancing First Lien Obligations, in each case whether now existing or hereafter arising, and whether or not allowed or allowable in any Insolvency Proceeding. To the extent any payment with respect to the First Lien Obligations is declared to be fraudulent or preferential or is otherwise required to be repaid, then the obligations so repaid shall be deemed to be reinstated and outstanding as First Lien Obligations for all purposes hereof.

D: First Lien Payment Default|means an Event of Default under Section 8.01(a) of the First Lien Credit Agreement (including, for the avoidance of doubt, any failure to pay principal, interest, fees or other amounts when due after giving effect to any applicable grace period).
N: The Second Lien Credit Agreement (§2.06(a)) refers to a “Payment Default or Bankruptcy Event of Default (each as defined in the First Lien Credit Agreement),” but the First Lien Credit Agreement does not define those terms — it uses them only as captions to §8.01(a) and (e). The First Lien Bankruptcy Default definition is first-lien-favorable in that blockage applies upon commencement of an involuntary case without waiting for the 60-day dismissal period.
D: First Lien Secured Parties|means the First Lien Agent, the First Lien Lenders, each issuing bank, each Hedge Counterparty, each Cash Management Bank and each other “Secured Party” under and as defined in the First Lien Credit Agreement, and their respective successors and assigns.
D: First Lien Security Documents|means the “Security Documents” as defined in the First Lien Credit Agreement and any other agreement, document or instrument pursuant to which a Lien is granted to secure any First Lien Obligations.
D: Grantors|means the Borrower, Holdings, each other Guarantor and each other Person that has granted or purports to grant a Lien on any of its assets to secure any First Lien Obligations or Second Lien Obligations. As of the date hereof, the Grantors other than the Borrower and Holdings are CTS Engineering Solutions, Inc., a Delaware corporation, CTS Fabrication Services, LLC, an Oklahoma limited liability company, CTS Assembly & Testing, LLC, a Louisiana limited liability company, and CTS IP Holdings, Inc., a Delaware corporation.
D: Guarantors|means the “Guarantors” as defined in the First Lien Credit Agreement and the “Guarantors” as defined in the Second Lien Credit Agreement.
N: The Guarantor definitions do not match. Under the First Lien Credit Agreement, a future Domestic Subsidiary becomes a Guarantor only upon joining the Guarantee Agreement under §6.12; under the Second Lien Credit Agreement, “Guarantors” means Holdings and “each existing and future Domestic Restricted Subsidiary” automatically. The instructions refer to “domestic restricted subsidiaries.” Section 2.3 below requires the guarantor groups to be identical and requires any Second Lien-only guarantee or Lien to be held in trust for the First Lien Secured Parties.

D: Proceeds|means (a) all “proceeds” as defined in Article 9 of the Uniform Commercial Code with respect to any Collateral and (b) whatever is recoverable or recovered when Collateral is sold, exchanged, collected or disposed of, whether voluntarily or involuntarily, including insurance proceeds and condemnation awards and any payment or distribution in any Insolvency Proceeding in respect of Collateral.
D: Recovery|has the meaning assigned to such term in Section 6.4.
D: Refinance|means, in respect of any Indebtedness, to refinance, extend, renew, defease, amend, restate, increase, modify, supplement, restructure, refund, replace or repay, or to issue other Indebtedness in exchange or replacement for such Indebtedness, in whole or in part; and “**Refinanced**” and “**Refinancing**” have correlative meanings.
D: Refinancing First Lien Obligations|means obligations under any Indebtedness that Refinances First Lien Obligations in accordance with Section 5.6.
D: Required First Lien Lenders|means the “Required Lenders” as defined in the First Lien Credit Agreement.

Confirm the Second Lien “Required Lenders” definition in the full execution version.
D: Second Lien Credit Agreement|means that certain Second Lien Credit Agreement, dated as of October 15, 2024, among the Borrower, Holdings, the lenders from time to time party thereto, and Trident Capital Markets LLC, as Administrative Agent and Collateral Agent, as amended, restated, amended and restated, supplemented, extended, replaced, refinanced or otherwise modified from time to time to the extent permitted by this Agreement, and any agreement governing Indebtedness that Refinances Second Lien Obligations in accordance with Section 5.6.

D: Second Lien Obligations|means all “Second Lien Obligations” as defined in the Second Lien Credit Agreement, including all principal, interest (including interest accruing after the commencement of any Insolvency Proceeding, whether or not allowed), fees, premiums, indemnification obligations and other amounts owing under the Second Lien Documents.
D: Second Lien Secured Parties|means the Second Lien Agent, the Second Lien Lenders and each other “Second Lien Secured Party” under and as defined in the Second Lien Credit Agreement, and their respective successors and assigns.
D: Second Lien Security Documents|means the “Second Lien Collateral Documents” as defined in the Second Lien Credit Agreement and any other agreement, document or instrument pursuant to which a Lien is granted to secure any Second Lien Obligations.

D: Standstill Period|means the period commencing on the date of delivery by the First Lien Agent to the Second Lien Agent of an Enforcement Notice or a Payment Blockage Notice and ending on the date that is 180 days thereafter; __provided__ that, if a new Event of Default under the First Lien Credit Agreement that is distinct from the Event of Default giving rise to the then-existing Standstill Period occurs during such Standstill Period and the First Lien Agent delivers a new Enforcement Notice or Payment Blockage Notice with respect thereto, the Standstill Period shall restart on the date of delivery of such new notice and shall end on the date that is 180 days thereafter, and there shall be no limit on the number of such restarts; __provided further__ that the Standstill Period shall be deemed to be continuing at all times during which any Insolvency Proceeding is pending.

H1: ARTICLE II — LIEN PRIORITIES
S: 2.1|Relative Priorities|Notwithstanding (a) the date, time, order, manner or method of grant, creation, attachment or perfection of any Liens securing the Second Lien Obligations granted on the Collateral or of any Liens securing the First Lien Obligations granted on the Collateral, (b) any provision of the Uniform Commercial Code, any other applicable law or any Second Lien Document or First Lien Document, (c) whether the First Lien Agent or any First Lien Secured Party, or the Second Lien Agent or any Second Lien Secured Party, holds possession of or control over all or any part of the Collateral, (d) the fact that any First Lien Liens may be subordinated, voided, avoided, invalidated or lapsed, or (e) any other circumstance whatsoever, the Second Lien Agent, on behalf of itself and each other Second Lien Secured Party, hereby agrees that: (i) any Lien on the Collateral securing any First Lien Obligations now or hereafter held by or on behalf of the First Lien Agent or any First Lien Secured Party, regardless of how acquired, shall be senior in all respects and prior to any Lien on the Collateral securing any Second Lien Obligations; and (ii) any Lien on the Collateral securing any Second Lien Obligations now or hereafter held by or on behalf of the Second Lien Agent or any Second Lien Secured Party, regardless of how acquired, shall be junior and subordinate in all respects to all Liens on the Collateral securing any First Lien Obligations. All Liens on the Collateral securing any First Lien Obligations shall be and remain senior in all respects and prior to all Liens on the Collateral securing any Second Lien Obligations for all purposes, whether or not such Liens securing any First Lien Obligations are subordinated to any Lien securing any other obligation of any Grantor or any other Person.
S: 2.2|Effect of Defects in Perfection; Prohibition on Contesting Liens|(a) The priorities set forth in Section 2.1 shall apply, and the Second Lien Liens shall be junior and subordinate to the First Lien Liens, even if any First Lien Lien is not perfected, is perfected after any Second Lien Lien, has lapsed or is otherwise unperfected, unenforceable, void, voidable, avoided, subordinated or invalid, or is subject to any defect in attachment, perfection or priority, whether by reason of any failure to file, record, deliver possession, obtain control or otherwise. No Second Lien Secured Party shall assert, and each Second Lien Secured Party hereby irrevocably waives, any claim that any defect in or failure of perfection of any First Lien Lien affects the priorities established by this Agreement.
I: (b) Each of the Second Lien Agent, for itself and on behalf of each other Second Lien Secured Party, agrees that it shall not (and hereby waives any right to) directly or indirectly contest, or support any other Person in contesting, in any proceeding (including any Insolvency Proceeding), (i) the attachment, perfection, priority, validity, extent or enforceability of any First Lien Lien or any First Lien Obligations, (ii) the relative rights and duties of the Secured Parties established by this Agreement or (iii) the validity or enforceability of any provision of this Agreement; and shall not seek, in any proceeding or otherwise, to have any Second Lien Lien equalized with, or made pari passu with or senior to, any First Lien Lien, or to have any First Lien Lien subordinated, primed or recharacterized. Nothing in this Section 2.2(b) shall impair the rights of the First Lien Agent or any First Lien Secured Party to enforce this Agreement.
S: 2.3|Identical Collateral; No Additional Second Lien Liens or Guarantees|(a) The parties intend that the Collateral securing the Second Lien Obligations shall be the same as (and shall not exceed) the Collateral securing the First Lien Obligations, and that the Guarantors of the Second Lien Obligations shall not include any Person that is not a Guarantor of the First Lien Obligations. The Second Lien Agent, for itself and on behalf of each other Second Lien Secured Party, agrees that no Second Lien Secured Party shall acquire or hold any Lien on any assets of any Grantor or any other Person, or any guarantee by any Person, securing or supporting any Second Lien Obligations that are not also subject to a First Lien Lien or a guarantee of the First Lien Obligations, as applicable, unless the First Lien Agent has been offered such Lien or guarantee on a senior basis and has declined it in writing.
I: (b) If any Second Lien Secured Party shall nonetheless acquire or hold any Lien or guarantee in contravention of Section 2.3(a), then, without limiting any other right or remedy of the First Lien Secured Parties, such Second Lien Secured Party shall, without the need for further consent of any Person, (i) hold such Lien or guarantee, and any Proceeds thereof, in trust for the benefit of the First Lien Agent and the other First Lien Secured Parties and (ii) promptly notify the First Lien Agent and either release such Lien or guarantee or assign it to the First Lien Agent as security for the First Lien Obligations (in which case the Second Lien Agent may retain a junior Lien or guarantee subject to this Agreement).
I: (c) After-Acquired Collateral. Each of the parties agrees that whenever the First Lien Agent obtains a Lien on any property or assets of any Grantor (including any after-acquired property and any Equity Interests of any Person that becomes a Domestic Subsidiary after the date hereof and any additional Equity Interests of a Foreign Subsidiary pledged pursuant to Section 6.12(c) of the First Lien Credit Agreement), the Second Lien Agent shall automatically, and without further action by any Person, be entitled to (and the applicable Grantor may grant) a second-priority Lien on such property or assets, which Lien shall be junior and subordinate in all respects to the First Lien Liens thereon and subject to the terms of this Agreement.
N: The instructions call for an automatic second-priority Lien on all after-acquired First Lien Collateral. We have combined that with a market “identical collateral” provision (clauses (a) and (b)), which was not specifically requested but protects against the scope differences between the two credit agreements: the Second Lien Credit Agreement collateral description expressly includes letter-of-credit rights and commercial tort claims and refers only to 65% of the voting Equity Interests of first-tier Foreign Subsidiaries (the First Lien Credit Agreement also takes 100% of non-voting Equity Interests and has a §6.12(c) step-up to 100%). The parties should confirm the two collateral packages are identical before signing.

S: 5.5|Refinancing|(a) The First Lien Obligations and the Second Lien Obligations may each be Refinanced, in whole or in part, at any time, in each case without notice to, or the consent (except to the extent a consent is otherwise required to permit the Refinancing transaction under any First Lien Document or Second Lien Document) of, the First Lien Agent, the Second Lien Agent or any other Secured Party, all without affecting the Lien priorities provided for herein or the other provisions hereof; __provided__ that (i) the holders of such Refinancing Indebtedness (or an authorized agent or trustee on their behalf) bind themselves in writing to the terms of this Agreement pursuant to a joinder substantially in the form of Exhibit A or such other documents or instruments as the First Lien Agent (or, in the case of a Refinancing of the First Lien Obligations, the new First Lien Agent) may reasonably request, or enter into a replacement intercreditor agreement on terms substantially the same as the terms hereof, and (ii) the execution and delivery of such joinder or replacement intercreditor agreement by the replacement First Lien Agent or replacement Second Lien Agent, as applicable, shall be a condition precedent to the closing of such Refinancing.
I: (b) In connection with any Refinancing of the First Lien Obligations, the Second Lien Agent agrees, at the request of the new First Lien Agent or the Borrower, to (i) enter into such documents and agreements (including amendments or supplements to this Agreement or a replacement intercreditor agreement on terms substantially the same as the terms hereof) as the Borrower or such new First Lien Agent shall reasonably request in order to provide to the holders of Refinancing First Lien Obligations the rights contemplated hereby, and (ii) acknowledge that such Refinancing First Lien Obligations shall be treated as First Lien Obligations for all purposes hereof. Any Refinancing First Lien Obligations shall be subject to Section 5.3 as if such Refinancing were an amendment of the First Lien Credit Agreement, mutatis mutandis.
I: (c) Any Indebtedness that Refinances the Second Lien Obligations shall (i) not have a maturity date earlier than, or a weighted average life to maturity shorter than, the Second Lien Obligations being Refinanced, (ii) not have any scheduled amortization or mandatory prepayment provisions, (iii) not be in an aggregate principal amount in excess of the principal amount of the Second Lien Obligations being Refinanced plus accrued interest, premiums, fees and expenses incurred in connection therewith, (iv) not be secured by Liens on assets other than the Collateral or guaranteed by Persons other than the Guarantors, and (v) otherwise comply with Section 5.4 as if such Refinancing were an amendment of the Second Lien Documents.

H1: ARTICLE V — RELEASES; AMENDMENTS; REFINANCING
S: 5.1|Automatic Release of Second Lien Liens and Guarantees|(a) If, at any time, (i) any Collateral is sold, transferred or otherwise disposed of, or any First Lien Lien on any Collateral is released, or any Guarantor is released from its guarantee of the First Lien Obligations, in each case in connection with any transaction permitted under the First Lien Credit Agreement (including any asset sale or other disposition, any release of a Guarantor, any designation of a Subsidiary as an Unrestricted Subsidiary or any release consented to by the Required First Lien Lenders or such other First Lien Lenders as may be required under the First Lien Credit Agreement), [or (ii) the First Lien Agent or the First Lien Secured Parties (or any Grantor with the consent of the First Lien Agent) sell, transfer or otherwise dispose of any Collateral in connection with any Enforcement Action or in any Insolvency Proceeding (including pursuant to Section 363 of the Bankruptcy Code),] then the Second Lien Liens on such Collateral (but not on the Proceeds thereof, which shall remain subject to the Second Lien Liens to the extent of any Proceeds remaining after application in accordance with Section 4.1) and the guarantee of the Second Lien Obligations by such Guarantor shall be automatically, unconditionally and simultaneously released and terminated, to the same extent as the First Lien Liens or guarantee, as applicable, are released, without any further action by or consent of the Second Lien Agent or any other Second Lien Secured Party, and the Second Lien Agent and each other Second Lien Secured Party shall be deemed to have authorized and consented to such release; __provided__ that this Section 5.1(a) shall not apply to any release in connection with the Discharge of First Lien Obligations (other than in connection with an Enforcement Action or disposition described above).
N: Instruction §8 requires an automatic, simultaneous release in any transaction permitted under the First Lien Credit Agreement; Second Lien Credit Agreement §9.18(h) is consistent. Bracketed clause (ii) extends the release to dispositions in First Lien enforcement and in Insolvency Proceedings (which are not “permitted” transactions because they occur after an Event of Default). This is standard in first-lien-favorable forms and goes beyond the literal instruction; please confirm. The proviso is market and preserves the Second Lien Liens upon a payoff of the First Lien (otherwise Caldwell Reed will argue the clause could be used to strip their Liens on a refinancing).
I: (b) The Second Lien Agent shall, and shall cause each other Second Lien Secured Party to, promptly (and in any event within three (3) Business Days of request) execute and deliver to the First Lien Agent or the applicable Grantor such termination statements, releases, lien and mortgage releases and other documents as the First Lien Agent or such Grantor may reasonably request to effectively confirm the releases described in Section 5.1(a). Any failure to do so shall not affect the automatic effectiveness of such releases.
S: 5.2|Power of Attorney|Until the Discharge of First Lien Obligations, the Second Lien Agent, for itself and on behalf of each other Second Lien Secured Party, hereby irrevocably constitutes and appoints the First Lien Agent and any officer or agent of the First Lien Agent, with full power of substitution, as its true and lawful attorney-in-fact with full irrevocable power and authority in the place and stead of the Second Lien Agent or such Second Lien Secured Party, as applicable, and in its name or in the First Lien Agent’s own name, from time to time in the First Lien Agent’s discretion, for the purpose of carrying out the terms of Section 5.1, to take any and all appropriate action and to execute any and all documents and instruments that may be necessary or desirable to accomplish the purposes of Section 5.1, including any endorsements, assignments, termination statements, releases or other instruments of transfer or release. This power of attorney is coupled with an interest and is irrevocable.
N: Irrevocable power of attorney per instruction §8. Second Lien Credit Agreement §11.02(a) authorizes the Second Lien Collateral Agent to bind the Second Lien Secured Parties to the ICA, which should be sufficient, but Caldwell Reed should confirm the authority covers a power of attorney; mortgage releases in Ohio, Oklahoma and Louisiana may require a recordable form of power of attorney (confirm with local counsel).
S: 5.3|Amendments to First Lien Documents|(a) The First Lien Documents may be amended, restated, supplemented, waived or otherwise modified in accordance with their terms, and the First Lien Obligations may be Refinanced, in each case without notice to or the consent of the Second Lien Agent or any other Second Lien Secured Party, all without affecting the Lien subordination or other provisions of this Agreement; __provided__ that, without the prior written consent of the Required Second Lien Lenders, no such amendment, supplement or modification shall:
II: (i) extend the final scheduled maturity date of the term loans under the First Lien Credit Agreement beyond October 15, 2031 [__alternative:__ to a date later than July 16, 2032 (the date that is 91 days prior to the scheduled maturity of the Second Lien Obligations)];
II: (ii) increase the aggregate principal amount of commitments and loans under the First Lien Credit Agreement above $365,000,000 [plus [$[•]] [[15]% of such amount]] (being the sum of the $310,000,000 Term Commitment and the $55,000,000 Revolving Commitment on the date hereof), less the aggregate amount of all permanent repayments of term loans and permanent reductions of revolving commitments thereunder (other than in connection with a Refinancing); __provided__ that the following shall not be subject to or count against such limitation: (A) Protective Advances (not to exceed $5,000,000 at any time outstanding), (B) interest, fees, premiums (including the Prepayment Premium), costs, expenses and indemnities, including any such amounts that are capitalized or paid in kind, (C) Hedging Obligations and Cash Management Obligations, (D) any original issue discount, and (E) any DIP Financing permitted under Section 6.1;
II: (iii) increase the “Applicable Margin” for the term loans or revolving loans under the First Lien Credit Agreement by more than 200 basis points per annum above the Applicable Margin in effect on the date hereof (after giving effect to any exercise of the Market Flex Right on or prior to the date hereof), it being understood that (A) any increase resulting from the accrual of interest at the Default Rate, (B) any change in the SOFR Floor or any benchmark replacement, conforming change or spread adjustment, (C) any original issue discount, upfront fees or other fees (other than margin), (D) any change in interest rates resulting solely from fluctuations in the underlying benchmark rate and (E) any payment of interest in kind or capitalization of interest shall not constitute an increase in the Applicable Margin for purposes of this clause (iii); or
II: (iv) cause any Grantor to grant Liens on any assets that do not constitute Collateral (as described in the First Lien Security Documents as in effect on the date hereof) to secure the First Lien Obligations, unless a Lien on such assets is also offered to the Second Lien Agent on a junior basis subject to this Agreement; __provided__ that this clause (iv) shall not restrict (A) any Lien on after-acquired property or on the Equity Interests or assets of any Person that becomes a Grantor, in each case required by Section 6.12 of the First Lien Credit Agreement or the First Lien Security Documents as in effect on the date hereof, (B) any pledge of additional Equity Interests of a Foreign Subsidiary under Section 6.12(c) of the First Lien Credit Agreement, (C) any cash collateral for letters of credit or (D) any Lien securing DIP Financing permitted under Section 6.1.
N: Conflicts and judgment calls in this Section. (1) Clause (i): instruction §9(a)(1) requires Second Lien consent to __any__ extension beyond October 15, 2031. That restriction is unusually generous to the Second Lien (the usual protection is that the First Lien cannot be extended past, or within 91 days of, the Second Lien maturity of October 15, 2032). We drafted per instructions and bracketed the market alternative. (2) Clause (ii): instruction §9(a)(2) prohibits any increase in aggregate commitments, with no headroom; as drafted literally, that would capture Protective Advances (First Lien Credit Agreement §2.13), capitalized interest and incremental debt, and would sit awkwardly with the DIP cap. We carved those out and bracketed a cushion for your decision. (3) Clause (iii): First Lien Credit Agreement §2.10(c) Market Flex allows the Arranger to raise the margin from Term SOFR + 400 bps to + 450 bps (and take up to 200 bps of OID) without Required Lender consent, on or before the Closing Date. The baseline is set after flex so a flex exercise does not consume the 200 bps cushion; the Default Rate (+2.00%, i.e., 200 bps, under §2.04(e)) is excluded so that a default would not itself trigger the restriction; floors and fees are excluded (the facilities have different SOFR floors — 0.75% First Lien versus 1.00% Second Lien). Obtain closing confirmation of the final margin. (4) Clause (iv): instruction §9(a)(4) (no collateral beyond the original package) conflicts with instruction §3 (after-acquired property), First Lien Credit Agreement §6.12(b) and §6.12(c). Drafted as a narrower restriction protective of the First Lien’s existing rights; please confirm.
I: (b) Second Lien Ratchet. If any amendment to the First Lien Credit Agreement increases the Applicable Margin by more than 200 basis points per annum in the manner described in Section 5.3(a)(iii) (with the consent of the Required Second Lien Lenders), then the Second Lien Credit Agreement may be amended, without the consent of any First Lien Secured Party, to increase the “Applicable Margin” thereunder by an amount not to exceed [the amount of such increase in the First Lien Applicable Margin] [__alternative:__ the amount by which such increase exceeds 200 basis points per annum], and any interest at such increased rate shall constitute regularly scheduled interest for purposes of Section 4.2(a).
N: Ratchet per instruction §9(a)(3) (“the Second Lien Lenders shall have the right to increase the Second Lien interest rate by a corresponding amount”). The instructions say the Second Lien “gets to match the increase,” which reads as the full amount of the First Lien increase; we drafted that as the primary text. The bracketed alternative (only the excess over 200 bps) is more first-lien-favorable, but would re-trade the agreed compromise; flagged only so you can confirm the intended measure.
S: 5.4|Amendments to Second Lien Documents|(a) Without the prior written consent of the First Lien Agent (acting at the direction of the Required First Lien Lenders), no Second Lien Document may be amended, restated, supplemented, waived or otherwise modified, or entered into, to the extent such amendment, supplement, modification or new Second Lien Document would:
II: (i) shorten the scheduled maturity date of the Second Lien Obligations to a date earlier than the date that is ninety-one (91) days after the final scheduled maturity date under the First Lien Credit Agreement (i.e., earlier than [January 14, 2032], based on the First Lien maturity of October 15, 2031) or, if later, the then-scheduled maturity of any Refinancing First Lien Obligations;
II: (ii) increase the aggregate principal amount of the Second Lien Term Loan or the commitments under the Second Lien Credit Agreement to an amount in excess of $115,000,000 (other than by the capitalization of interest payable in kind, if permitted under the Second Lien Credit Agreement as in effect on the date hereof);
II: (iii) add or modify any financial maintenance covenant in a manner that is more restrictive to the Grantors than the financial maintenance covenant set forth in the First Lien Credit Agreement (Section 9.01 thereof, a First Lien Net Leverage Ratio covenant of 5.75 to 1.00, tested only when Revolving Loans exceed 35% of the Revolving Commitment), it being understood that any financial maintenance covenant in the Second Lien Documents shall include a cushion of not less than [25]% to the corresponding First Lien covenant level;
II: (iv) add any mandatory prepayment, redemption or offer-to-purchase provision [or any scheduled amortization payment], or otherwise change the time of payment of principal or interest to an earlier date; [or]
II: [(v) change any Event of Default or covenant (or add any new Event of Default or covenant) in a manner that is more restrictive to the Grantors, or increase the “Applicable Margin” under the Second Lien Credit Agreement other than as permitted by Section 5.3(b), or otherwise contravene the provisions of this Agreement.]
N: Conflict — maturity date. The instructions (§9(b)(1)) and Second Lien Credit Agreement §9.18(j) both describe the floor as “91 days after the First Lien maturity (i.e., earlier than July 16, 2031).” Ninety-one days after October 15, 2031 is January 14, 2032; July 16, 2031 is 91 days __before__ the First Lien maturity. Clauses (i)-(iv) are the instructed restrictions; the [25]% cushion language in clause (iii), the bracketed amortization language in clause (iv) and bracketed clause (v) are first-lien-favorable additions for your review (currently the Second Lien Credit Agreement excerpts contain no financial maintenance covenant and Second Lien Credit Agreement §2.05(b) and §2.06(b) provide for no amortization and no mandatory prepayments).
I: (b) The Second Lien Agent agrees that each Second Lien Security Document shall include the following legend (or a similar legend reasonably acceptable to the First Lien Agent): “Notwithstanding anything herein to the contrary, the lien and security interest granted to the Second Lien Collateral Agent pursuant to this Agreement and the exercise of any right or remedy by the Second Lien Collateral Agent hereunder are subject to the provisions of the First Lien/Second Lien Intercreditor Agreement, dated as of October 15, 2024 (as amended, restated, supplemented or otherwise modified from time to time, the “Intercreditor Agreement”), among Pinnacle Credit Advisors LLC, as First Lien Agent, Trident Capital Markets LLC, as Second Lien Agent, and the other parties thereto. In the event of any conflict between the terms of the Intercreditor Agreement and this Agreement, the terms of the Intercreditor Agreement shall govern.”
I: (c) In the event that the First Lien Agent or the First Lien Secured Parties enter into any amendment, waiver or consent in respect of any First Lien Security Document for the purpose of adding to or deleting from, or waiving or consenting to any departure from, any provisions thereof, or changing in any manner the rights of the First Lien Agent, the First Lien Secured Parties or any Grantor thereunder (in each case to the extent not prohibited by Section 5.3), then such amendment, waiver or consent shall apply automatically to any comparable provision of the comparable Second Lien Security Document without the consent of any Second Lien Secured Party; __provided__ that no such amendment, waiver or consent shall (i) remove assets subject to the Second Lien Liens except to the extent such release is permitted under Section 5.1 or (ii) impose duties on the Second Lien Agent without its consent; and __provided further__ that written notice thereof is given to the Second Lien Agent within ten (10) Business Days after its effectiveness (but the failure to give such notice shall not affect the effectiveness thereof).
S: 5.5|Refinancing|(a) The First Lien Obligations and the Second Lien Obligations may each be Refinanced, in whole or in part, at any time, in each case without notice to, or the consent (except to the extent a consent is otherwise required to permit the Refinancing transaction under any First Lien Document or Second Lien Document) of, the First Lien Agent, the Second Lien Agent or any other Secured Party, all without affecting the Lien priorities provided for herein or the other provisions hereof; __provided__ that (i) the holders of such Refinancing Indebtedness (or an authorized agent or trustee on their behalf) bind themselves in writing to the terms of this Agreement pursuant to a joinder substantially in the form of Exhibit A or such other documents or instruments as the First Lien Agent (or, in the case of a Refinancing of the First Lien Obligations, the new First Lien Agent) may reasonably request, or enter into a replacement intercreditor agreement on terms substantially the same as the terms hereof, and (ii) the execution and delivery of such joinder or replacement intercreditor agreement by the replacement First Lien Agent or replacement Second Lien Agent, as applicable, shall be a condition precedent to the closing of such Refinancing.

Any Refinancing First Lien Obligations shall be subject to Section 5.3 as if such Refinancing were an amendment of the First Lien Credit Agreement, mutatis mutandis.

N: Refinancing per instruction §10 (both facilities may be refinanced at any time; replacement debt must be subject to this Agreement or a replacement intercreditor agreement on substantially the same terms; joinder of the replacement agent is a closing condition).
